test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In which of the following months is Gokulashtami celebrated every year as per Hindu tradition?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhadrapada.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Krishna Janmashtami celebrated this year on August 30.
 
• The festival marks the birth of Lord Krishna and is celebrated on the eighth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Bhadrapada (August-September) in India.
 
• It is also known as Krishna Janmashtami or Gokulashtami. 
 
• According to Hindu mythology, Krishna, the human incarnation of Lord Vishnu, was born on this day to destroy Mathura's demon king, Kansa, the brother of Krishna's virtuous mother, Devaki.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
As per the Vikram Samvat, the following are the months in a calendar year :

 
 
• Chaitra
 
• Vaishak
 
• Jyastha
 
• Aashad
 
• Shravan
 
• Bhadrapad
 
• Ashwin
 
• Kartik
 
• Agrahayna
 
• Pausa
 
• Magh
 
• Phalgun
